name: Zebra Meat
subtitle: Recipe by Greta and Denise
notes: AKA “HoHo 99 Chicken OK”. Formulated in the summer of 1999, Oklahoma. May turn leftovers into chicken salad by mixing with ½ cup mayonnaise, ½ cup sour cream, and sugar, salt, pepper, apples, celery, raisins, and water chestnuts.

items: Approx. 4 pounds chicken breasts, sliced to ¾-inch thick

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.body: Mix the marinade: **¼ cup soy sauce**, **1 cup sour cream**, **4 cloves garlic**, **1 tsp curry powder**, **½ tsp ginger** and **juice of 4 limes**.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.body: Pour the marinade over **approx. 4 pounds chicken breasts**, sliced to ¾-inch thick, and marinate for 2-12 hours.
